title: Locator
description: Normalized, stable source reading locator within an edition of a publication. Normative rule: a locator never carries a rendered page number (page numbers vary dynamically with screen size, font size, margins, and device DPI). Enforces exact edition binding via edition_fingerprint, spine coordinates, character offsets, progression percentages, EPUB CFI, and text quotes for resilient relocation.

doc_id.description: Stable publication or work identifier (e.g., URN, UUID, or catalog ID).

edition_fingerprint.description: Edition-binding fingerprint (e.g. SHA-256 hash of normalized text or OPF package). Used to detect edition mismatches; locators are edition-bound and must not be used across mismatched editions.

spine_index.description: Zero-based index of the spine item in the publication reading order.

spine_item_id.description: Manifest identifier of the spine item from the EPUB package document.

spine_href.description: Resource path (href) of the spine item relative to the publication root.

char_offset.description: Zero-based character offset within the spine item or normalized chapter text.

char_range.description: Character offset range within the spine item or normalized chapter text.

progression.description: Relative progression within the spine item (0.0 to 1.0 inclusive).

total_progression.description: Relative progression within the entire publication (0.0 to 1.0 inclusive).

cfi.description: EPUB Canonical Fragment Identifier (CFI) for fine-grained DOM-level anchoring.

text_quote.description: Textual context around the target location for resilient re-anchoring across reflows or minor text shifts.
